description: This file defines React components and hooks for managing and displaying a table of user property attributes in the Mattermost admin console, including creation, editing, deletion, and reordering of custom user attributes.

methods.name: useUserPropertiesTable
methods.description: Custom hook that manages the state and actions for the user properties table, including loading data, creating, saving, and canceling changes.

methods.name: UserPropertiesTable
methods.description: React component that renders the user properties table with columns for attribute name, type, values, and actions, supporting editing, reordering, and deletion.

methods.name: ActionsCell
methods.description: Component rendering action menu or delete button for a user property field, depending on whether the field is orphaned.

methods.name: EditCell
methods.description: Component for inline editing of a text field with auto-focus and change handling.
